prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1386; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact collision at intersection. Insured reports other vehicle entered intersection against signal. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles on file from first notice of loss call.

Entry 2: Claimant represented by counsel. Letter of representation received. All further contact to go through attorney's office. Recorded statement from insured completed. Insured states no prior claims on this loss and no injuries reported at scene.

Entry 3: Claimant has reported neck strain following impact. Medical records requested through counsel. Authorization forms sent to attorney's office. Vehicle damage appraisal scheduled at repair facility. Rental coverage confirmed for insured.

Entry 4: Liability review in progress. Witness statement obtained from pedestrian at corner. Traffic camera footage requested from municipal office, retention window noted. Initial liability assessment leans toward other driver at fault, pending police report review.

Entry 5: Attorney's office responded with treatment summary for neck strain, including physical therapy referral. Records reviewed. Claim reserve adjusted to reflect bodily injury exposure. Supervisor review requested before any settlement discussion. File remains open pending medical updates and police report.
